<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Swim Through Earth](/Feats.aspx?ID=4230) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 27

</column>

---

The earth parts before you, letting you swim through it. You gain a burrow Speed equal to your land Speed and can immediately [Burrow](/Actions.aspx?ID=93) once. You don't gain the ability to breathe while in the earth, so you must [hold your breath](/Rules.aspx?ID=468). The impulse ends at the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. If you're inside the earth when the impulse ends, you immediately return to the surface directly above you, fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) when you reach the surface, and are [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35) until the end of your next turn.

---
**Level (14th)** You can burrow through rock and similar dense earthen matter, leaving no tunnels or signs of your passing.
name: Swim Through Earth
